title: Harden the service's Dockerfile
prompt:
Security review of our Dockerfile: it uses `python:latest`, runs as root, has no health check and bakes the database
password into the image. Harden it: pin the base image to a specific tag (keep Python 3.12, slim), run as a non-root
user, add a `HEALTHCHECK` that hits `http://localhost:8000/healthz`, and remove the secret from the image (the password
comes from the environment at run time). The app must still start with `python app.py`.
